snippet.title: Working on Explosives : Paw Rescuers
snippet.description:
Just wanted to share the current progress. We are pretty close to finishing the terrain mechanics, and hopefully will be able to start working on some gameplay mechanics very soon. Our main goal is making something playable for super early alpha testing. Join our discord to stay tuned with the updates.

Discord https://discord.gg/zwg6z8aPav
Wishlist on Steam https://store.steampowered.com/app/3268370/Paw_Rescuers/
